audit.whatIsWrong: CROSS-LAYER DISAGREEMENT: content win[0] and win[1] read "Lux" while full-layer phases[0].side and phases[1].side read "Skill". The page rendered two different answers to who wins Level 1 and Level 2.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Lux, Lux, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill — it agrees with the content layer, and both full-layer whys for those rows describe Lux poking freely. Lux Q 1175 / E 1100 versus Taliyah Q 1000 / W 900 supports the early edge.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side moved to Lux to match win[0]/win[1], which already read Lux. Rows 3 onward stay Skill on both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Weaver's Wall (180/150/120s, 2500/4500/6500 range) is a map tool rather than a duel spike, so level 6 stays even; Lux's Final Spark is 60/50/40s. Threaded Volley dropping from 7s to 3s is Taliyah's real lane spike and is now named in the cooldowns field.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number in it, and nothing on the page stated the actual stun requirement.
audit.why: Unraveled Earth only stuns enemies that DASH through it or are KNOCKED through it. Lux has no dash, so the minefield alone cannot stun her — Taliyah must land Seismic Shove (14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, 900 range) to knock Lux into the mines. That single fact is the whole all-in: dodge the shove and there is no stun. Threaded Volley's grounding is likewise inert against Lux, who has no dash to ground.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and phases[2].why now state the shove-into-mines requirement with the 14s rank-1 number.

audit.why: Worked Ground and Rock Surfing wall speed are already reflected in spikes[2].text; nothing further is verifiable from the kits alone.
